entry.method: normalized Hermite bone directions, endpoint lengths, and root Hermite

input_boundary.interpretation: Geometric boundary diagnostics only; skin, feet, obstacles and contact require review.

limitations: Authored motion, not jointly generated with Core.
Bone directions and lengths are interpolated; no limb shortening from position blending.
Endpoint velocity is measured at sampled frames; continuous derivatives alone are not proof.
No foot locking, floor, partner-contact or obstacle solve.

approach.method: Core world bone directions with native actor median segment lengths
approach.floor_policy: Preserve source minimum ankle/toe height with one Y-only root translation each frame.
limitations: Core wrist and elbow endpoints move as part of this explicit morphology retarget.
No FK from the old 17-bone rig and no InterGen-to-Core conversion.
Core foot sliding is not repaired; ground contact and mesh penetration remain unverified.
Native source lengths vary while Core display lengths use actor-specific medians.

features: No unified model features; preserve source archives separately.
